pairs.subject: measurement-honesty
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/model.ts:66 The caution text treats successful judge calls as the total and can claim every call errored despite successful calls, contradicting the published counts.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/model.ts:65 Calls counts successes, so comparing errors against that count cannot establish that all calls errored; four successes and four errors trigger the false headline.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/ReportPage.tsx:172 The page displays per-tone findings without calculating a controlled A/B contrast or handling a recorded failed control.

apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/Layer1.tsx:27 At the page acquisition boundary, absent report data produces no triptych values, and an unanswered proposal query leaves its count absent instead of inventing zero.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/Incidents.tsx:101 The tally is explicitly scoped to logged report incidents, with separate pagination totals, rather than claiming external reach or usage.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/ReportPage.tsx:181 Every present quality rate renders as a percentage regardless of n; small-sample warnings elsewhere do not implement the required refusal.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/CountUp.tsx:29 The animation interpolates a snapshot count; the page does not announce metric deltas or maintain metric-based classification transitions.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/ReportPage.tsx:131 The SES mean is displayed beside total runs without showing ses_n or the observed fraction when some segment ends lack SES.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/DiffView.tsx:20 The diff view presents proposed edits without publishing measured savings or reductions attributable to them.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/PlanPage.tsx:106 The page submits selected future plan options; it does not fit an artifact against a corpus or publish a subsequent benchmark measurement.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/CountUp.tsx:28 Elapsed time drives visual animation rather than measuring the computational cost of hosted work.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/DirectiveOutcomes.tsx:33 An absent directive rate receives a no-judgment explanation, while a measured zero remains a distinct k-of-n result.

declined.subject: measurement-honesty
declined.reason: withdrawn after review: reviewer (sonnet): stats.rs:10 returns None for n=0 and every Rate carries n and a Wilson or rule-of-three bound, so it is not an unbounded percentage. I also could not confirm in runs.rs that malformed lines let explicitly selected runs reach normal analysis with an empty measured set.
